description: Upsert order status, on a table whose only unique index on status is composite.
rationale: The refusal merge_no_unique shows, in the form that was actually missed: a UNIQUE (status, id) index LEADS with status and does not make status unique. Measured on 18.6, a table with UNIQUE (id, tenant) and two rows sharing id = 1 was accepted as proof, and the MERGE updated both rows. The transcript shows the refusal naming the index and saying why it does not count.
